lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between blobs increases as they progress posteriorly, with larger, more isolated circular clusters appearing in the mid-flank region compared to the high-density, smaller clusters on the cranial section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a faint but discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance (upper) to low-luminance/shadow (lower).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette, visible at the dorsal midline, contains a dense distribution of small, roughly circular high-luminance blobs distributed relatively uniformly across its visible surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is visible positioned ventrally to the left pectoral fin.
